source_text: Go to Eve Cathedral and get Zephaniah’s journal…

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.Go to Eve Cathedral and get Zephaniah’s journal…
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.Go to Eve Cathedral and get Zephaniah’s journal…"

translation: Idź do Katedry Ewy i przynieś dziennik Zephaniaha…

source_text: Once we open the rift, I will face Madalyn and we will steal back the Toma Leolo.

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.Once we open the rift, I will face Madalyn and we will steal back the Toma Leolo.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.Once we open the rift, I will face Madalyn and we will steal back the Toma Leolo."

translation: Kiedy otworzymy rozdarcie, stawię czoła Madalyn i odzyskamy Tomę Leolo.

source_text: You’re going to get my men!

structure.raw_value: DuAnDe^.You’re going to get my men!
structure.script_literal: "DuAnDe^.You’re going to get my men!"

source_text: No… The men are gone. Get the Toma.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.No… The men are gone. Get the Toma.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.No… The men are gone. Get the Toma."

source_text: Artifact hunting in a moment like this?

structure.raw_value: DuAnDe^.Artifact hunting in a moment like this?
structure.script_literal: "DuAnDe^.Artifact hunting in a moment like this?"

translation: Polowanie na artefakty w takiej chwili?

source_text: I trust the priest. He says they are dead.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.I trust the priest. He says they are dead.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.I trust the priest. He says they are dead."

translation: Ufam księdzu. Mówi, że nie żyją.

source_text: Their souls have been sent to judgment. Their bodies will be used as vessels for monsters.

structure.raw_value: BrAnEx.Their souls have been sent to judgment. Their bodies will be used as vessels for monsters.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnEx.Their souls have been sent to judgment. Their bodies will be used as vessels for monsters."

translation: Ich dusze staną przed sądem. Ich ciała posłużą potworom za naczynia.

source_text: Who cares? I just need bodies. Find my men.

structure.raw_value: DuAnDe^.Who cares? I just need bodies. Find my men.
structure.script_literal: "DuAnDe^.Who cares? I just need bodies. Find my men."

translation: Co mnie to obchodzi? Potrzebuję tylko ciał. Znajdź moich ludzi.

source_text: Give me some time. I’ll find them.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Give me some time. I’ll find them.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Give me some time. I’ll find them."

translation: Daj mi trochę czasu. Znajdę ich.

source_text: Make yourself useful, Canmore.

structure.raw_value: DuAnDe^.Make yourself useful, Canmore.
structure.script_literal: "DuAnDe^.Make yourself useful, Canmore."

source_text: 1Hero, Henry here says you heard the name Lilith.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.1Hero, Henry here says you heard the name Lilith.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.1Hero, Henry here says you heard the name Lilith."

translation: 1Hero, Henry mówi, że słyszałeś imię Lilith.

source_text: It’s what Lillian said… But she didn’t look like herself.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.It’s what Lillian said… But she didn’t look like herself.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.It’s what Lillian said… But she didn’t look like herself."

translation: Tak powiedziała Lillian… Ale nie wyglądała jak ona sama.

source_text: Lilith is a demon from Hell, but she shouldn’t exist.

structure.raw_value: BrWoDe.Lilith is a demon from Hell, but she shouldn’t exist.
structure.script_literal: "BrWoDe.Lilith is a demon from Hell, but she shouldn’t exist."

translation: Lilith to demon z piekła, ale nie powinna istnieć.

source_text: So you say.

structure.raw_value: HrBaOp^.So you say.
structure.script_literal: "HrBaOp^.So you say."

source_text: What are you talking about? She called herself Lilith.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.What are you talking about? She called herself Lilith.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.What are you talking about? She called herself Lilith."

translation: O czym ty mówisz? Sama nazwała się Lilith.

source_text: Lilith is Jewish folklore and, as we all know, Catholicism is the one true religion.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.Lilith is Jewish folklore and, as we all know, Catholicism is the one true religion.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.Lilith is Jewish folklore and, as we all know, Catholicism is the one true religion."

translation: Lilith pochodzi z żydowskiego folkloru, a jak wszyscy wiemy, jedyną prawdziwą religią jest katolicyzm.

source_text: I think you picked the wrong religion.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.I think you picked the wrong religion.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.I think you picked the wrong religion."

source_text: Ah… But may I remind you that my powers worked on those demons.

structure.raw_value: BrFlDe.Ah… But may I remind you that my powers worked on those demons.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlDe.Ah… But may I remind you that my powers worked on those demons."

translation: Ach… Ale przypomnę, że moje moce zadziałały na tamte demony.

source_text: I’m telling you, it’s Lilith… But she had bigger boobs than she had as Lillian… and a demon-like face.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I’m telling you, it’s Lilith… But she had bigger boobs than she had as Lillian… and a demon-like face.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I’m telling you, it’s Lilith… But she had bigger boobs than she had as Lillian… and a demon-like face."

translation: Mówię ci, to Lilith… Ale miała większe cycki niż jako Lillian… i demoniczną twarz.

source_text: That’s very strange… If she’s a demon, how does she leave through the portal?

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.That’s very strange… If she’s a demon, how does she leave through the portal?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.That’s very strange… If she’s a demon, how does she leave through the portal?"

translation: To bardzo dziwne… Jeśli jest demonem, jak może przechodzić przez portal?

source_text: Maybe Lillian is her human form.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Maybe Lillian is her human form.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Maybe Lillian is her human form."

translation: Może Lillian jest jej ludzką postacią.

source_text: Never heard of a human form… Maybe she’s a demi-demon.

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe.Never heard of a human form… Maybe she’s a demi-demon.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnDe.Never heard of a human form… Maybe she’s a demi-demon."

translation: Nie słyszałem o ludzkiej postaci… Może jest półdemonem.

source_text: I wish I could tell you I know how to stop her… but I can’t come up with any ideas.

structure.raw_value: HrWoOp^.I wish I could tell you I know how to stop her… but I can’t come up with any ideas.
structure.script_literal: "HrWoOp^.I wish I could tell you I know how to stop her… but I can’t come up with any ideas."

translation: Chciałbym wiedzieć, jak ją powstrzymać… ale nie mam żadnego pomysłu.

source_text: Father, take Zephaniah’s journal… Maybe there’s something in it you can use.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Father, take Zephaniah’s journal… Maybe there’s something in it you can use.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Father, take Zephaniah’s journal… Maybe there’s something in it you can use."

translation: Ojcze, weź dziennik Zephaniaha… Może znajdziesz w nim coś przydatnego.

source_text: Kimberly!

structure.raw_value: McShCl.Kimberly!
structure.script_literal: "McShCl.Kimberly!"

source_text: Save her!

structure.raw_value: ElAnAg.Save her!
structure.script_literal: "ElAnAg.Save her!"

source_text: They could be anywhere now!

structure.raw_value: HrWoCl^.They could be anywhere now!
structure.script_literal: "HrWoCl^.They could be anywhere now!"

source_text: How many were there?

structure.raw_value: BrWoOp.How many were there?
structure.script_literal: "BrWoOp.How many were there?"

source_text: Four… Plus the girl.

structure.raw_value: HrBaEx^.Four… Plus the girl.
structure.script_literal: "HrBaEx^.Four… Plus the girl."

source_text: I think I know where they are going.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.I think I know where they are going.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.I think I know where they are going."

source_text: Kimberly is going to try and broadcast the Toma on TV… But Paul won’t let her.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Kimberly is going to try and broadcast the Toma on TV… But Paul won’t let her.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Kimberly is going to try and broadcast the Toma on TV… But Paul won’t let her."

translation: Kimberly spróbuje pokazać Tomę w telewizji… Ale Paul jej na to nie pozwoli.

source_text: And that’s why she has a posse of demons: to take the studio by force.

structure.raw_value: DiAnOp.And that’s why she has a posse of demons: to take the studio by force.
structure.script_literal: "DiAnOp.And that’s why she has a posse of demons: to take the studio by force."

translation: Dlatego ma ze sobą bandę demonów: chcą siłą przejąć studio.

source_text: Madalyn and Lillian are still on the other side of the rift…

structure.raw_value: BrBaOp.Madalyn and Lillian are still on the other side of the rift…
structure.script_literal: "BrBaOp.Madalyn and Lillian are still on the other side of the rift…"

translation: Madalyn i Lillian wciąż są po drugiej stronie rozdarcia…

source_text: I have to keep watch.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.I have to keep watch.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.I have to keep watch."

source_text: But, Father, we have to stop the broadcast.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.But, Father, we have to stop the broadcast.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.But, Father, we have to stop the broadcast."

source_text: Go to the Channel 4 building. I’ll take care of the demon women.

structure.raw_value: ElBaEx^.Go to the Channel 4 building. I’ll take care of the demon women.
structure.script_literal: "ElBaEx^.Go to the Channel 4 building. I’ll take care of the demon women."

translation: Idź do budynku Channel 4. Ja zajmę się demonami.

source_text: I can’t believe I’m saying this, but I’m glad a priest is here.

structure.raw_value: BoWoEx.I can’t believe I’m saying this, but I’m glad a priest is here.
structure.script_literal: "BoWoEx.I can’t believe I’m saying this, but I’m glad a priest is here."

translation: Nie wierzę, że to mówię, ale cieszę się, że jest tu ksiądz.

source_text: Bring me Zephaniah’s journal. It should be in the cathedral library.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.Bring me Zephaniah’s journal. It should be in the cathedral library.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.Bring me Zephaniah’s journal. It should be in the cathedral library."

translation: Przynieś mi dziennik Zephaniaha. Powinien być w bibliotece katedry.

source_text: Father, I found the journal.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Father, I found the journal.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Father, I found the journal."

source_text: You better hurry. I’m getting impatient.

structure.raw_value: DuAnDe^.You better hurry. I’m getting impatient.
structure.script_literal: "DuAnDe^.You better hurry. I’m getting impatient."

source_text: How are the girls holding up?

structure.raw_value: BrBaOp.How are the girls holding up?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaOp.How are the girls holding up?"

source_text: I haven’t seen them.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.I haven’t seen them.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.I haven’t seen them."

source_text: Give me the journal and go back and make sure they are safe. This could take a while.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.Give me the journal and go back and make sure they are safe. This could take a while.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.Give me the journal and go back and make sure they are safe. This could take a while."

translation: Daj mi dziennik, a potem wróć i upewnij się, że są bezpieczne. To może trochę potrwać.

source_text: I’ll find them and make sure they are safe.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I’ll find them and make sure they are safe.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I’ll find them and make sure they are safe."

translation: Znajdę je i dopilnuję, by nic im się nie stało.

source_text: Judy is missing! Madalyn took her!

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Judy is missing! Madalyn took her!
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Judy is missing! Madalyn took her!"

source_text: Shit! Where did she go?

structure.raw_value: BrWoOp.Shit! Where did she go?
structure.script_literal: "BrWoOp.Shit! Where did she go?"

source_text: The usual place… Into a puff of black smoke.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.The usual place… Into a puff of black smoke.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.The usual place… Into a puff of black smoke."

translation: Jak zwykle… Zniknęła w kłębie czarnego dymu.

source_text: Take the journal and see what you can figure out. I’m going back to the church to find Sister Judy.

structure.raw_value: BrAnEx.Take the journal and see what you can figure out. I’m going back to the church to find Sister Judy.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnEx.Take the journal and see what you can figure out. I’m going back to the church to find Sister Judy."

translation: Weź dziennik i sprawdź, czego możesz się z niego dowiedzieć. Wracam do kościoła szukać siostry Judy.

source_text: What’s the deal? Why isn’t the rift open?

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.What’s the deal? Why isn’t the rift open?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.What’s the deal? Why isn’t the rift open?"

translation: O co chodzi? Czemu rozdarcie nie jest otwarte?

source_text: I’m working on it. Give me some time.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.I’m working on it. Give me some time.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.I’m working on it. Give me some time."

translation: Pracuję nad tym. Daj mi trochę czasu.

source_text: I’m with the sexy cop. You need to move faster.

structure.raw_value: DuAnEx^.I’m with the sexy cop. You need to move faster.
structure.script_literal: "DuAnEx^.I’m with the sexy cop. You need to move faster."

translation: Jestem z seksowną policjantką. Musisz się pospieszyć.

source_text: A feisty one!

structure.raw_value: DuFlDe^.A feisty one!
structure.script_literal: "DuFlDe^.A feisty one!"

source_text: Diana is surprisingly knowledgeable about the Casula.

structure.raw_value: BrFrOp.Diana is surprisingly knowledgeable about the Casula.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrOp.Diana is surprisingly knowledgeable about the Casula."

translation: Diana zaskakująco dużo wie o Casulach.

source_text: But hopefully Henry comes back with something helpful.

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.But hopefully Henry comes back with something helpful.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.But hopefully Henry comes back with something helpful."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że Henry wróci z czymś przydatnym.
